project.name: Dubton
project.boundarySource: Mapped named-place location with a conservative editorial study buffer
project.researchNotes: Catalogue-addition settlement gate. Nearby attractions, heritage properties and nature reserves do not inflate the place score. Angus-wide full audit completed 2026-09-01: all six visitor categories, the four named commercial trail providers, current official/conventional routes, strict-boundary scoring and local HES/NRHE integrity were checked.

touristAppeal.label: Minor Interest

townGuide.headline: Fully audited for catalogue completeness
townGuide.intro: Dubton scores 24% after a strict-boundary audit of See, Eat, Trails, Picnic, Parking, Toilets and local HES/NRHE evidence. Dubton remains selector-only at 24% after a complete audit found no independently publishable visitor place or practical facility.
perfectFor: Identifying the locality while planning a wider Angus route
townGuide.visitorMood: Kept in the selector with its assessed score, but deliberately absent from the tourist-town map below 60.

townStudyArea.sourceName: Mapped named-place location with a conservative editorial study buffer
townStudyArea.notes: Dubton has no separate NRS locality polygon in the reference dataset. The published editorial boundary is therefore the strict heritage study area; the 500 m ring is context only.

sources.name: Historic Environment Scotland NRHE / trove.scot Points GIS
sources.coverage: NRHE records whose representative points lie within the authoritative Dubton parish extent
sources.accessMethod: Developer-supplied local HES Shapefile; exact parish containment
sources.licence: Open Government Licence v3.0; retain Historic Environment Scotland attribution.
sources.limitations: The spatial index provides a representative site point, names and classifications. It does not establish construction dates; detailed source records require individual review.

sources.name: Historic Environment Scotland Scheduled Monuments spatial data
sources.coverage: Scheduled monuments intersecting the strict editorial boundary
sources.accessMethod: Developer-supplied local HES Shapefile; exact boundary intersection
sources.licence: Open Government Licence v3.0; retain Historic Environment Scotland attribution.
sources.limitations: The spatial layer supplies designation and location, not a historic construction period. Undated records remain in the catalogue but are hidden from the heat map.

sources.name: Historic Environment Scotland Listed Buildings spatial data
sources.coverage: Dubton editorial district plus 500m heritage buffer; buffer records are retained as related context
sources.accessMethod: Developer-supplied local HES Shapefile; exact polygon selection
sources.licence: Open Government Licence v3.0; retain Historic Environment Scotland attribution.
sources.limitations: Dubton has no separate NRS locality boundary. The transparent visitor-guide editorial boundary is used and buffer records remain context only. The source supplies statutory designation and location metadata, not construction dates.
